Weight loss mistakes 👇 A calorie deficit is always king when it comes to losing weight. “Healthy eating” is subjective, and the seemingly “healthier” choice isn’t always the better choice for your goals. I’m not saying to live off junk food if it’s low calorie, but I am saying you should understand how all foods can fit when you’re trying to lose weight. 1. Eating too little — Your body needs enough food and energy to function properly. 2. Expecting overnight results — Healthy progress takes time, so be patient with yourself. 3. Ignoring your daily steps — Using a walking app can help you track your steps, stay motivated and work towards your daily movement goals! (I use Fastwalk) 4. Not drinking enough water — Keep a water bottle nearby and drink regularly throughout the day. 5. Doing workouts you hate — Find activities you genuinely enjoy so it’s easier to stay consistent. 6. Comparing your progress to others — Everyone’s body and journey are different, so focus on yourself. 7. Being too hard on yourself — Remember, consistency matters more than perfection. Give yourself grace! 💗 #gymtok #weightlosstips #glowuptips #motivation
